filenames.name: mimikatz.exe
filenames.recommendation: Immediately isolate the affected host and investigate credential theft.

filenames.name: nc.exe
filenames.recommendation: Verify whether the process is legitimate and inspect active network connections.

filenames.name: nmap.exe
filenames.recommendation: Check if the scan was authorized. Review the source host.

filenames.name: psexec.exe
filenames.recommendation: Investigate remote execution activity and isolate the endpoint if necessary.

filenames.name: procdump64.exe
filenames.recommendation: Check if LSASS memory was dumped. Isolate the host and rotate credentials.

filenames.name: wce.exe
filenames.recommendation: Treat as active credential theft. Isolate the host immediately.

filenames.name: rubeus.exe
filenames.recommendation: Investigate for Kerberoasting or ticket forgery. Review domain controller logs.

filenames.name: bloodhound.exe
filenames.recommendation: Check for unauthorized AD enumeration. Review the source account's privileges.

filenames.name: lazagne.exe
filenames.recommendation: Determine what credential stores were accessed. Rotate exposed credentials.

filenames.name: powersploit.ps1
filenames.recommendation: Review PowerShell execution history and script block logging on the host.

filenames.name: empire.ps1
filenames.recommendation: Treat as an active C2 implant. Isolate the host and inspect outbound connections.

filenames.name: cobaltstrike_beacon.exe
filenames.recommendation: Isolate the host immediately and inspect network traffic for C2 patterns.

filenames.name: anydesk.exe
filenames.recommendation: Confirm whether remote access was authorized by IT/Security before allowing it to run.

filenames.name: teamviewer_qs.exe
filenames.recommendation: Confirm whether remote access was authorized by IT/Security before allowing it to run.

filenames.name: svchost32.exe
filenames.recommendation: Legitimate svchost.exe does not run from user-writable folders. Investigate immediately.

filenames.name: wannacry.exe
filenames.recommendation: Disconnect the host from the network immediately. Do not pay ransom. Restore from backup.

filenames.name: DECRYPT_INSTRUCTIONS.txt
filenames.recommendation: This is a strong indicator of an active ransomware incident. Isolate the host and activate the incident response plan.
